Note: PB Apr '24: These may not be all available data but are what I have and are a realistic cross-section. No data for inconspicuous species is available from the file I have, and there will be few or no data for these (as e.g. Scymnus and Rhyzobius larvae can usually only be identified to genus, not species level)
